intro:

It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Carex turbinata var. rigens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
